result_excerpt:
Implemented a minimal Spring Boot web app that serves "Hello" at `/`.

### Changes

1. **`pom.xml`** — Added `spring-boot-devtools` (runtime, optional). Web is already covered by `spring-boot-starter-webmvc`; Java 17 is set.

2. **`HelloController.java`** — New REST controller that serves an HTML page with "Hello" at `/`:

```java
@GetMapping(value = "/", produces = MediaType.TEXT_HTML_VALUE)
public String hello() {
    return "<html><body>Hello</body></html>";
}
```

3. **`Dockerfile`** — Already present at the repo root; no changes needed.

### Verification

- `./mvnw -DskipTests package` — build succeeded
- `docker build` — image built successfully
- `GET /` — returns `<html><body>Hello</body></html>`

Run locally with `./mvnw spring-boot:run` or `java -jar target/demo-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`, then open http://localhost:8080/.
